subject: re-st
title: RE.ST.------PROG.CONT.
description: Chart on book p. 495 (TRF(II)-31). RE-ST (restructuralism) is the subject, with the (R) prefix, "the reality of"; PROG-CONT (progressional continuance) is the partner. From the subject: INFO-DY, AFL (affinity alignment) and TR-INFO (trans-information). From INFO-DY: RE-ST-2 (restructuralism, a second re.st. label, without prefix). From RE-ST-2: LANG-DY (language dynamics). From AFL: PER-DY (perception dynamics) and RIT-DY (ritual dynamics). From RIT-DY: INFO-DE-B (information degrees). From TR-INFO: T-C-IMP (time continuum implications). From T-C-IMP: STF (source transfer).
